### Rubrik to Present at Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference


August 27, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s203.q4cdn.com/667520861/files/doc_news/Rubrik-to-Present-at-Goldman-Sachs-Communacopia--Technology-Conference-2026.pdf)


PALO ALTO, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Rubrik, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.rubrik.com%2F&esheet=54595403&newsitemid=20260827453559&lan=en-US&anchor=Rubrik%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=06927ae995006d5e8335bff32f0249bb) (NYSE: RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, today announces that it is scheduled to present at the following investor conference:


Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference
Location: San Francisco
Date: Thursday, September 10, 2026
Presentation Time: 9:30 a.m. PT


The presentation will be webcast live and archived on the Company’s investor relations website at[https://ir.rubrik.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.rubrik.com&esheet=54595403&newsitemid=20260827453559&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fir.rubrik.com&index=2&md5=40309c95dd8031bec6e4d9ef00260f16) .


**About Rubrik**


Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes. For more information, please visit[www.rubrik.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.rubrik.com&esheet=54595403&newsitemid=20260827453559&lan=en-US&anchor=www.rubrik.com&index=3&md5=774fb5bf38304016f0f7d62be01966f4) and follow[@rubrikInc](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FrubrikInc&esheet=54595403&newsitemid=20260827453559&lan=en-US&anchor=%40rubrikInc&index=4&md5=8c90e2a86458b350f9a7818e7dd073e1) on X (formerly Twitter) and[Rubrik](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Flinkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Frubrik-inc%2Fmycompany%2F%27&esheet=54595403&newsitemid=20260827453559&lan=en-US&anchor=Rubrik&index=5&md5=0989ec230e94ff24529be4d00a606b61) on LinkedIn.
